errors._screen: Error messages for requests the API rejects before any feature handles them (unreadable body, unknown address, oversized body). Short, say what happened; never blame the person.
errors.malformed_json: The request body could not be parsed; asking to try again is enough.
errors.not_found: The API address does not exist.
errors.body_too_large: The request body is over the size limit; do not give the limit.
